jobs.description:
Your role
Bring your curiosity to work as our next Agile Coach.

You will be part of the Compressor Technique Information Services (CT-IS) organization and report to the Hiring Manager CT-IS.

In this role, your mission is to drive agile transformation, strengthen ways of working, and help teams, leaders, and stakeholders create measurable customer and business value through continuous improvement and collaboration.
Your day-to-day
• Lead and support the Agile transformation by developing and implementing improvement initiatives, roadmaps, and ways of working across the organization.
• Coach Scrum Masters, Product Owners, teams, and leaders to strengthen collaboration, self-management, continuous improvement, and value delivery.
• Facilitate cross-team alignment, coordination, and scaling practices to improve transparency, efficiency, and collaboration.
• Design and deliver workshops, training sessions, and learning initiatives focused on Agile, Scrum, Kanban, DevOps, and product development practices.
• Monitor, measure, and continuously improve Agile adoption, team effectiveness, and organizational performance through meaningful metrics and feedback loops.
• Identify organizational impediments and drive improvements that contribute to sustainable business outcomes and customer value.
Your skills and experience
• Proven experience as an Agile Coach, senior Scrum Master, transformation coach, or a comparable role within Agile product development, IT delivery, or organizational transformation.
• Strong practical knowledge of Agile principles, Scrum, Kanban, and continuous improvement practices.
• Experience coaching Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and cross-functional teams in complex organizational environments.
• Strong facilitation, training, stakeholder management, and organizational change management skills.
• Experience working with Agile collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft Teams, combined with excellent English communication skills.
We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are interested in what you can bring to the role.

Are you passionate about data and data analysis, and do you enjoy combining functional insight with technical depth? Do you get energy from engaging with stakeholders as well as from structuring and modelling data into a reliable foundation for insights and reporting? Do you enjoy considering how business needs and data from different sources can be brought together in clear, scalable data models? Then a role as a Data Analyst within our Data & AI team might be the perfect fit for you!

• You work closely with experienced colleagues on Business Intelligence, Data and AI projects, primarily within the Microsoft Cloud
• You analyse business questions and translate them into clear functional requirements, data requirements and technical specifications for the further development of the data solution
• You facilitate workshops with stakeholders to identify information needs, KPIs, definitions and business rules
• You design and optimise conceptual, logical and dimensional data models that provide a reliable foundation for reporting and analytics
• You map data sources, data flows and their interrelationships, while ensuring data consistency and quality
• You collaborate closely with business stakeholders, data engineers and data architects to deliver scalable data solutions
• You document data definitions, business rules and models and contribute to clear data governance agreements
• You support the translation of data models into user-friendly analyses and reports.
What you need to succeed:
• You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree, preferably in Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Business IT & Management, Data Science or a related field
• You have several years of relevant experience as a Data Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst or in a similar data-focused role, preferably within a consultancy environment
• You have experience with functional analysis and with gathering, analysing and structuring business and data requirements. You can translate business needs into clear functional and technical solutions
• You have strong knowledge of data modelling, including dimensional models, star schemas and data warehousing concepts. Knowledge of Kimball and Data Vault is a strong asset
• You are proficient in SQL and can analyse, validate and prepare datasets for analytical use
• You have experience with Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, including building data models, reports and dashboards. You also have a good knowledge of DAX
• Experience with Python for data analysis, data transformation or automation is an asset.
• You understand how data sources, data flows, data quality and data governance come together in a reliable data environment. Data engineering experience is an asset
• You have strong communication skills and can clearly explain complex business and data challenges to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You feel comfortable in a client-facing environment and confidently facilitate workshops and requirements sessions
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and can also express yourself professionally in English
• You are flexible and willing to travel, as you will regularly work on-site at client locations. When your presence at the client is not required, you can combine working from home with working from the Cegeka office closest to you (Antwerp, Ghent, Diegem, Hasselt or Leuven).

Your role
AI-assisted engineering is already delivering step-change results inside our Compressor Technique Service division, where 250+ people build and run the software behind our connected industrial equipment. Those results have come, so far, from a self-selecting group of early adopters. The next step is harder and worth far more: making AI-assisted work the normal way of working for the whole delivery organisation: from hardcore developers to testers and people who (almost) never open an IDE (such as business analyst and POs).

 

Lead the division-wide adoption of AI-assisted and agentic engineering across every team that builds and ships software; developers, but equally product owners, business analysts, test engineers, designers and support. This is a people job before it is a technical one: a year from now you will be judged on how many colleagues work differently, not on how much you personally built. It needs the credibility of an engineer who has shipped real systems and the energy of someone who can make a skeptical room want to try something on Monday morning. 
Your day-to-day
• Create the pull. Lead the Compressor Technique Aftermarket AI community of practice; the demos, showcases, hackathons and lunch sessions that make people want in, and connect it to the wider Atlas Copco community.
• Bring the non-developers with you. Product owners, business analysts, test engineers, designers and support colleagues each need use cases from their own work, in their own language, not a developer demo with the code hidden.
• Show, don’t tell. Build the prototypes, demos and reference implementations that prove what is possible yourself or with your ambassador network, then hand the pattern over to the teams.
• Grow contributors, not consumers. Get teams creating and sharing their own skills, agent files, prompts and starter packs. You own the framework, the quality bar and the curation, not the backlog of assets.
• Design and deliver knowledge from training (online/classroom), coach individuals and teams one-on-one, and whatever other format helps to push the knowledge needle.
• Define and roll out standards and governance for AI-assisted work, aligned with security, compliance and data policies, and integrated into Atlas Copco’s product development methodology.
• Establish a measurement framework: baseline and track adoption, productivity and quality, and build the ROI picture over time.
• Track the fast-evolving tooling landscape; run evaluations and follow up on investments in tooling, hardware, open models, and procurement.
Your skills and experience
• A track record of changing how other people work. A community of practice, an internal enablement or transformation programme, a guild, a training track; something where you held no formal authority and people came along anyway.
• The ability to make it click for anyone. You can explain agentic working to a test engineer, a product owner and a principal developer on the same day, and each of them leaves with something they can use tomorrow.
• At least 5 years of production-level software development and delivery experience. You will not be writing production code most days, but you will be coaching people who do; and they will know within a week whether you have done the work yourself.
• Hands-on across more than one stack (e.g. .NET, Python, Matlab, Flutter, data and/or embedded): enough to build a convincing prototype and to read anyone’s codebase.
• Demonstrated practical use of AI coding / agentic tools (Copilot, Claude, Codex, or equivalent) on real delivery work.
• Understanding of the evolving cost models of AI agents, and of the security impact of different AI alternatives.
• Familiarity with the full SDLC and with governance, security, and compliance considerations.
• Fluent English communication skills.
Nice to have 

• Experience with Databricks, Azure, Flutter, Matlab, or embedded / firmware environments.
• Exposure to ML / agent workflows and to evaluating models and tooling.
• Experience creating material people actually consume: internal talks, workshops, written guides, short video. 
We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role.

Do you enjoy working on the most innovative data solutions of the future? Then Cegeka has the challenge for you! Within our Data & AI team at Cegeka, we are looking for a Snowflake Data Engineer. As an expert in Snowflake, you will play a crucial role in our exciting Snowflake projects. We follow a “Public Cloud First” strategy and have established partnerships with Snowflake, Microsoft, and Databricks. Are you ready to join our team of specialists? Apply now and let your talent and experience contribute to our mission!

 

• As a Snowflake Data Engineer, you work closely with colleagues on data and AI projects for companies across various sectors.
• You develop and maintain robust, scalable ELT pipelines with dbt (including natively via dbt Projects on Snowflake), orchestrated with Apache Airflow or Snowflake Tasks, Streams and Dynamic Tables, with a strong focus on automation and reusability.
• You ingest data from source systems with Snowpipe (Streaming) and Snowflake Openflow / Apache NiFi, and transform it according to business logic into reliable data models on the central data platform. Data quality and robustness are key.
• You help build open lakehouse architectures with Apache Iceberg tables and Iceberg catalogs (Horizon Catalog, Snowflake Open Catalog/Polaris).
• You support domain teams following data mesh principles and deliver data products through secure data sharing and the Internal Marketplace.
• You safeguard governance (RBAC, masking and row access policies, tagging) and performance and cost (warehouse sizing, resource monitors, query profiling).
• You automate deployments through CI/CD and use CoCo (Cortex Code) to develop faster and better.
• You translate functional and technical requirements into concrete data solutions.
• Cegeka is a Snowflake partner, giving you direct access to their solution architects for technical challenges or specific questions.
 

What you need to succeed:
• You have extensive experience as a Data Engineer or in a hands-on data role within complex enterprise environments.
• You work with Snowflake daily and master SQL and Python (Snowpark).
• You have hands-on experience with dbt and with orchestration through Airflow or Snowflake Tasks and Dynamic Tables.
• You have experience with data integration through Snowpipe and Snowflake Openflow / Apache NiFi.
• You are familiar with Apache Iceberg tables and Iceberg catalogs (Horizon Catalog, Snowflake Open Catalog/Polaris, catalog integrations with e.g. AWS Glue or Unity Catalog).
• You know multi-cloud environments (Azure, AWS) and integrate them with Snowflake (storage integrations, external volumes, private connectivity).
• You work with CI/CD: version control in Git, automated deployments with Snowflake CLI and/or Terraform, and testing in the pipeline.
• You are familiar with Snowflake CoCo (Cortex Code), Snowflake's AI coding agent.
• You know Snowflake governance and cost management (RBAC, masking and row access policies, warehouse sizing, resource monitors).
• You have a solid background in data modeling (Data Vault, Kimball) and apply it in a scalable, maintainable way in production.
• You work according to a hybrid employment policy: from the Cegeka office near your place of residence (Ghent, Brussel, Hasselt, Antwerp, or Leuven), combined with working from home and on site at the customer.
• Nice to have: SnowPro Core / SnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer.
• You have excellent communication skills in English. Knowledge of Dutch and French is a strong asset.

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

jobs.occupation: Technician in day shift - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium in the area of Oostkamp-Bruges? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the area of Oostkamp or Bruges
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not obligated, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC... The company can teach you these on the job.

You have a technical degree in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience.

• Experience with PLC-controlled machines and industrial automation is considered a strong advantage.
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.

With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.
